en: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a grand building with classical architecture, featuring symmetrical windows, a mansard roof, and a formal garden with potted trees and outdoor chairs in the foreground. The top of the postcard has printed text identifying the location as 'Montluel (Ain) - Château Heer.' There is a handwritten signature or note along the right side of the postcard.
